# Am I Cancelled Yet?

> Am I Cancelled Yet? is an 88-minute documentary featuring actor and comedian Michael Rapaport, directed by Ruth Berdah-Canet and produced by Chosen Films LLC. It blends stand-up comedy with real-life drama, following Rapaport's emotional journey since October 7, 2023.

## About the film

- Title: Am I Cancelled Yet?
- Type: feature documentary, comedy and vérité
- Featuring: Michael Rapaport, with his wife Kebe
- Director: Ruth Berdah-Canet
- Producers: Michael Rapaport and Ruth Berdah-Canet
- Production company: Chosen Films LLC
- Runtime: 88 minutes
- Country: USA
- Languages: English and Hebrew
- Tagline: Silence isn't an option.

## Synopsis

At the heart of the film is Rapaport's stand-up show, the narrative thread that pulls audiences in and out of his story. Between the stage and real life, he visits the sites of the October 7 massacres, meets survivors and hostage families, and discovers a deepening connection to his Jewish identity. Back in the US, his outspoken support for Israel puts his career and reputation under pressure. His wife Kebe, a quiet and grounded presence beside him, shows the personal cost of being unapologetically visible. The film moves between laughter and grief, bravado and vulnerability, and asks what happens when shutting up is not an option.

## Key people

- Michael Rapaport: New York-born actor, director, comedian and podcast host. Films include True Romance, Beautiful Girls, Cop Land and Higher Learning; TV includes Friends, Prison Break, Justified and Atypical. Directed Beats, Rhymes & Life: The Travels of A Tribe Called Quest and ESPN's 30 for 30 When the Garden Was Eden. Hosts the I AM RAPAPORT: STEREO PODCAST.
- Ruth Berdah-Canet: award-winning documentary filmmaker, born in France, who has worked in Japan, New York and Israel. After October 7 she made films and campaigns with the Hostages and Missing Families Forum, where she met Rapaport.
- Team: Yael Tikalsky (editor), Emil Swaeid (cinematography), Jonathan Gvili "Argov" (music), Rotem Dror (sound design), Yoav Raz (colorist).
